notes.title: Paper Dolls 2: Escape—A Free DLC Available on October 29
notes.content:
Hi dear Paper Dolls fans!

[b]We will be launching Escape, a free DLC for Paper Dolls 2, on October 30 just in time for Halloween! Please stay tuned!!![/b]

Ghosts and spirits will prowl the mansion on All Hallows' Eve! Within the new game mode you will act as an exorcist, slaying spirits aplenty!
The merciless paper dolls are like marionettes on strings. Fleeting, a reflection of truths. You must rise up and face a challenge greater than ever if you are to survive. Tap into your wisdom and courage. Kill as you have never before, for a way out, to live…


https://store.steampowered.com/app/1453650/Paper_Dolls_2_Escape/

This DLC contains the two following game modes:
[b][i]You can play the new game modes WITHOUT first completing Paper Dolls 2's main story.[/i][/b]

[list]
[*]  Escape
[*]  Boss Frenzy
[/list]

[b]Features:[/b]

[list]
[*]  [b]New Game Modes[/b]
     Run for your life. Run until your muscles burn and your veins pump battery acid.  And make sure to explode each wine jar at the opportune moment to blow up as many paper dolls as possible.
[*]  [b]Boss Frenzy[/b]
      Face the three big bosses at once and defeat them in one fell swoop.
[*]  Score
      A new scoring system that grades you in both wisdom and courage.
[*]  [b]Difficulties[/b]
Choose between Easy, Normal, Hard, and Nightmare.
[/list]

notes.title: 问题修复报告
notes.content:

《纸人贰》上线已经是第26天了，非常感谢大家的中肯评价和建议，更加感激你们的理解与支持。
很多小伙伴的反馈建议已经收录到《纸人贰》玩家体验搜集库中，这是回馈给我们研发团队最宝贵的礼物，也将对我们今后的研发有很好的帮助。我们会不断努力哒，加油：）

1.修复了鬼怪生成机制中的BUG；
2.修复了鬼怪穿门的BUG；
3.修复了游戏中卡顿的问题；
4.修复了部分文献与语音不符的问题；
5.其他部分问题修复

再次感谢大家，欢迎感兴趣的小伙伴来社区讨论：对《纸人》系列后续，你将有怎样的期待？

如果游戏遇到问题，也可以到steam社区内进行讨论发帖，提供情报，最好附带图片和视频，方便我们查出问题所在，万分感激：）

notes.title: 对游戏进行了整体优化及部分问题修复

1.对游戏进行了整体优化，游戏帧数和流畅度都有所提升；

6.大逃亡结束后，删除了后台倒在地上的柜子；
7.修复了大逃亡时鬼手封门无法前进的问题；
8.完善了根据系统语言自动切换游戏中的语言功能；
9.修复了背包物品无法正常显示的问题；
10.及其他的部分问题修复
